episodes.title: Meet The Ba***ds
episodes.summary: Aasmaan's debut film scores big, earning him a contract at a star-studded bash. At an actors' roundtable, he throws shade at nepo-baby Karishma Talvar.

episodes.title: Movie Mafia
episodes.summary: Aasmaan meets Freddy and later signs a commercial to fund his father's surgery. Ajay disapproves of the male lead cast opposite his daughter.

episodes.title: Barbaad Mohabbat
episodes.summary: Parvaiz fanboys over Aasmaan and Karishma's new intimacy coach. A video of the leads goes viral for the wrong reasons. Freddy seeks Ajay's help.

episodes.title: Bullshit Party
episodes.summary: Avtar's hit song catches Karan Johar's attention. Ajay objects to the film's intimate scenes. Karishma's birthday party brings a huge surprise.

episodes.title: My Hero
episodes.summary: Jaraj shows Freddy an incriminating video of Aasmaan and pitches a plan. After falling out with Parvaiz, Aasmaan receives upsetting news.

episodes.title: The Filmfirst Awards
episodes.summary: Avtar turns away an unexpected guest. At a glamorous awards show, Aasmaan faces a pleasant surprise — but soon finds himself in trouble.

episodes.title: Picture Ka Title Hoga…
episodes.summary: As Aasmaan and Karishma try to elope with Parvaiz's help, Ajay chases after them. A shocking revelation threatens to upend Aasmaan's world.
